original1088.note: Direct MSG_RTN_GET_REALTIME bracket kernels sample one business dispatch per frame; rate from hipDeviceAttributeWallClockRate, adjacent-stamp median subtracted without clipping. Raw brackets retained. Four diagnostic dispatches added per profiled frame. Family sums reconstruct separate frames; not one simultaneous per-frame trace. CPU wall controls quantify probe effects. Family sums are diagnostic shares, not uninstrumented kernel costs. ACO stages have different fusion/layout boundaries; compare grouped work, not arbitrary one-to-one kernel names.
